facts.fact: Amnesty Kenya assesses the regulator's performance against the Data Protection Act, 2019, as the law in force.
Amnesty Kenya says the Office of the Data Protection Commissioner is operating and issuing orders.
facts.system: Office of the Data Protection Commissioner

facts.fact: Amnesty Kenya says in February 2026 the ODPC ordered St Luke's Orthopaedic Hospital to compensate patients and ordered an events company to pay KES 300,000 for using a woman's photograph without consent.
